answer: Reputation staking with slashing is a third mechanism: to grade or vote, an agent locks value it loses when caught favoring kin. Sybils must fund each fake with stake, and a comet-bright burst of new accounts has no earned history to borrow, so their votes weigh less until they age. The system is quartz hard because every forged endorsement costs locked collateral, not just a fresh keypair, and a grader tinting answers with biased pigment burns its own deposit. An attacker ends up paying more to corrupt the market than the market ever pays out.
